statements.subject: connection
statements.description: SYN-SENT state: the state in which a connection attempt has been initiated and a SYN has been sent, awaiting a corresponding SYN or SYN-ACK from the peer.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If the RST bit is set and the ACK was acceptable, then signal to the user 'error: connection reset', drop the segment, enter CLOSED state, delete TCB, and return.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If SND.UNA > ISS (our SYN has been ACKed), change the connection state to ESTABLISHED, form an ACK segment <SEQ=SND.NXT><ACK=RCV.NXT><CTL=ACK> and send it.
statements.trigger: SYN-ACK received (SYN bit on, ACK acceptable, SND.UNA > ISS)
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = SYN-SENT & segment.SYN = 1 & security_compartment_matches = true & SND.UNA > ISS
actions: remove acknowledged segments from retransmission queue

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Otherwise (SYN bit on but SND.UNA <= ISS, simultaneous open), enter SYN-RECEIVED, form a SYN,ACK segment <SEQ=ISS><ACK=RCV.NXT><CTL=SYN,ACK> and send it.
statements.trigger: SYN received without our SYN being ACKed (simultaneous open)
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = SYN-SENT & segment.SYN = 1 & security_compartment_matches = true & SND.UNA <= ISS

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If the ACK bit is set and SEG.ACK =< ISS or SEG.ACK > SND.NXT, send a reset (unless RST bit is set) <SEQ=SEG.ACK><CTL=RST> and discard the segment. Return. (No state change; segment is rejected.)
statements.trigger: ACK received with unacceptable ACK number
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = SYN-SENT & segment.ACK = 1 & (SEG.ACK <= ISS | SEG.ACK > SND.NXT) & segment.RST = 0
